payload.entry: ROOT-CAUSE EVIDENCE (from sase-ws land agent, 2026-09-06): a sibling models-panel node, tests/test_models_panel_layout.py::test_panel_preferred_width_fits_production_description, failed the same way under the check-full xdist lane (OptionDoesNotExist: no option 'large') and was root-caused precisely: ModelsPanel.__init__ sets self._views = [] (models_panel.py:207), so compose() renders only setting rows; alias rows appear only after the on_mount provider-snapshot THREAD worker completes and _apply_provider_snapshot(update_rows=True) rebuilds the option list. A single 'await pilot.pause()' does not wait for the thread under xdist load, so any read of alias rows right after mount races. This test's line ~88 get_option_index('small') after one pause has exactly that dependency; the notify assert may also race the second _emit_custom_builtin_shadow_warning fired on snapshot application. Deterministic fix pattern applied to the layout file as sase-ws landing work: 'await wait_for_snapshot_idle(pilot, panel)' (tests/_models_panel_helpers.py) after push_screen+pause, matching test_models_panel_navigation.py. Not a process-global state leak, so likely outside the sase-j7 class fix.

Backlog triage 2026-10-26: sase-x2, sase-125 and sase-1aj were closed as duplicates of this bead: all are the same models-panel race where tests call highlight_row/read alias rows after a single pilot.pause() before the on_mount provider-snapshot worker applies alias rows. One fix (make the shared helper in tests/_models_panel_helpers.py await wait_for_snapshot_idle before highlighting) covers tests/test_models_panel_display.py and tests/test_models_panel_edit_reset.py.

DORMANT AUDIT: kept open under sase-1ou dormant_flakes=close. Independently inspected Full CI 40400940314 at dd12f981ae, Python3.12 (2026-10-26): tests/test_models_panel_edit_reset.py::test_action_reset_custom_alias_deletes_custom_entry fails OptionDoesNotExist for blogger after mount. This is within the absorbed reset/helper scope in note2; the original named node having no recent report does not make this keeper dormant. No duplicate task.
